# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Go through each fire-safety system, and alter the `description` field to describe the issue.
3. Go through each system and change the `inspection` field to a `failure`.
4. Do a walkaround of the building. Along the way, alter the failing fire-safety systems that have clear photographic evidence to update the `evidence` field.
5. Look at the chronological view of inspection records. If you started the year with a few passes, make sure you go back in time and mark those inspections as failures.
